Program!*

organizing a 2 Month Training + Internship program designed by IBM.

*Here is an outline of the program's structure.*

*First month: *During the first month of the program, IBM training will be
conducted in the form of live lectures, and you will have live mentorship
from industry professionals. You will have access to the IBM Portal, where
you can interact with the trainers and fellow students. Login credentials
will be provided to registered students.

*Second month:* Internship with live mentorship for projects from
professionals. The LIVE INDUSTRY PROJECT will give students an experience
in solving real-world problems.
